speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: I need a pipeline that flags when a heatwave or a competitor promotion shifts our daily unit demand, not just a manual check. I cannot keep staring at graphs to find out if the forecast is drifting before the morning order window opens.
output.correction: You are reading my request as a complaint about the current manual process, but I am actually asking for an automated trigger that alerts us when the input distribution changes. I need the system to detect the shift so we can retrain before the next batch of replenishment orders goes out.
